title: Paloma Rewards Membership Service Terms by Tier
content:
These Paloma Rewards terms decide the support line a member is served on, what happens to points during a suspension, on an opt-out and on a refund, how soon an opted-out customer may rejoin, and how much history a points statement shows.

| Tier | Served on the priority support line | Points neither earned nor redeemed while suspended | Points forfeited on opt-out | Calendar days after an opt-out before enrolling again | Points earned on a transfer reversed when it is refunded | Months of history on a points statement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Blue | No | Yes | Yes | 90 | Yes | 12 |
| Paloma Rewards Silver | No | Yes | Yes | 90 | Yes | 12 |
| Paloma Rewards Gold | No | Yes | Yes | 90 | Yes | 24 |
| Paloma Rewards Platinum | Yes | Yes | Yes | 90 | Yes | 24 |
| Paloma Rewards Diamond | Yes | Yes | Yes | 90 | Yes | 36 |
| Paloma Rewards Elite | Yes | Yes | Yes | 90 | Yes | 36 |

## Reading the terms

- Priority support begins at Paloma Rewards Platinum; Blue, Silver and Gold members are not served on the priority line.
- On every tier points are frozen during a suspension, points still held are forfeited on opt-out, and points earned on a transfer that is later refunded are reversed.
- The rejoin wait is 90 calendar days on every tier.
- Statement history is 12 months on Blue and Silver, 24 months on Gold and Platinum, and 36 months on Diamond and Elite.
